source_snapshot.procedure: POST ForceRestart to Manager/AMC, ping the VNIC, GET Manager/AMC, compare LastResetTime/DateTime, PATCH DateTime and GET again.
source_snapshot.criteria: ForceRestart succeeds and patched Redfish time is synchronized with BMC time.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure fixed endpoint; performs reset/ping/GET but drops DateTime PATCH and final readback.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; restores separately gated reset/time write, bounded authenticated readiness, authoritative clock/tolerance and recovery.

old_problem: Malformed spaced URLs, fixed HTTP/-k and ping-as-ready do not prove Manager/AMC application recovery. Supported ResetType, return timeout, LastResetTime semantics, authoritative time/timezone, synchronization tolerances and recovery are absent. DeepSeek omits the required DateTime PATCH/readback entirely.
disposition_reason: The source clearly requires two state changes: SMC ForceRestart and DateTime PATCH. Each is retained behind a separate explicit gate. Protected application-level Redfish identity/health polling replaces ping, while signed time-source/UTC-offset and delta rules prevent invented PASS thresholds. Logs are preserved and reset is never blindly repeated after an uncertain outcome.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2053, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2054 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01065-V003 / 608dc52df578cda5 was directly read from XLSX.
ICMP reachability can precede Manager/AMC readiness and does not prove the same manager identity, health or tasks; bounded authenticated GETs are required.
LastResetTime and DateTime need schema semantics and an approved comparison tolerance to prove the intended reset rather than a stale/cached value.
DateTime may be controlled by NTP; its authoritative source, timezone/offset and acceptable set/readback delta must be approved before PATCH, and the original state retained for recovery.
ForceRestart and DateTime PATCH are independently authorized only when no firmware/stress/recovery/management task is active; any uncertain reset outcome stops without retry.
No Redfish GET/POST/PATCH, SMC reset, time change, ping, authentication, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: SMC ForceRestart application recovery and authoritative DateTime write/readback
test_case.purpose: Prove the exact SMC Manager/AMC performs one authorized ForceRestart and returns application-ready with a fresh LastResetTime, then separately write/read back an approved DateTime consistent with the authoritative BMC clock and synchronization policy.
required_package: Exact row-2053 variant plus SUT/BMC/SMC Manager identity, health, sessions and active-task baseline
Protected Manager/AMC endpoint/schema/authentication, supported ResetType and application-ready fields
Approved reset timeout/poll cadence and LastResetTime freshness/comparison rule
Authoritative BMC/NTP time source, timezone/UTC-offset, PATCH format and LastResetTime/DateTime/final-sync tolerances
Separate reset and time-write authorizations, maintenance exclusions, console and non-repeating recovery path
test_case.test_command: TWO-GATE STATE-CHANGING TEST; preserve BMC/SMC/SEL/host logs, manager identity, original DateTime/offset/NTP state, LastResetTime and active tasks. Gate 1 authorizes one protected TLS Redfish ForceRestart of the exact Manager/AMC only when no conflicting task exists. Capture POST response, interruption and bounded authenticated GET recovery until the same identity is application-ready; ping is supplemental only. Validate fresh LastResetTime. Gate 2 separately authorizes one DateTime PATCH using the approved authoritative timestamp/offset after the manager is healthy; capture request/response and repeated GET readback under the approved tolerance/NTP behavior. Do not clear logs, use malformed URLs, repeat reset or retry writes automatically.
test_case.expected_result: One authorized ForceRestart returns the same Manager/AMC to healthy application-ready state within the approved timeout with a fresh policy-compliant LastResetTime; one separately authorized DateTime PATCH succeeds and readback remains synchronized to the authoritative BMC time within the signed tolerance and offset policy, without task/session/health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact identity, conflict-free maintenance, successful one-time reset, bounded application readiness, valid fresh LastResetTime, authorized time write and compliant final readback/synchronization. FAIL on unsupported reset, non-return, wrong/stale identity/time, unexpected task/session/health loss, PATCH failure or out-of-tolerance/offset result. Missing semantics/tolerances/approval/recovery is NOT READY; ping alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Do not reset during firmware update, stress, recovery or active management work; preserve all evidence first.
ForceRestart and DateTime PATCH require separate explicit authorizations naming endpoint, value/scope and expiry.
Use protected TLS/session credentials and bounded authenticated polling; stop on non-return, identity/task loss or unexpected clock jump.
No automatic reset/PATCH retry, log clearing or guessed time correction; preserve uncertain state for recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, manager identity/health/sessions/tasks and original time/NTP/LastResetTime
Protected endpoint/schema, ResetType/time semantics, signed tolerances and separate authorizations
ForceRestart POST response plus interruption and bounded application-level recovery timeline
Pre/post LastResetTime analysis and one DateTime PATCH request/response with redacted credentials
Final repeated Manager/AMC DateTime/offset/NTP/health/task readback against authoritative clock
No-clear/no-repeat audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On reset non-return, identity/task loss or time/PATCH anomaly, stop and preserve console, Redfish, clock and SEL state. Do not issue another ForceRestart or DateTime write. Use the pre-approved console/SMC recovery under new human authorization; if time changed incorrectly, restore only from the recorded authoritative source after manager health is proven.

source_conflict.reason: Protected exact endpoints, application-level readiness and signed time semantics/tolerances resolve malformed URLs, ping-only proof and missing write coverage without weakening either state change.
